title: TV shows no signal from Apple TV
shortDescription: Apple TV 4K connected but TV reports no signal.
fullDescription: Apple TV 4K outputs 4K Dolby Vision by default. If your TV or HDMI chain cannot handle that, you get no signal. Most commonly caused by a non-HDMI 2.1 certified cable or an older AVR in between.

fixSteps.title: Swap HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use Apple's or certified Premium High Speed cable.

fixSteps.title: Hold Menu + Volume Down
fixSteps.instruction: Forces Apple TV to reset video resolution.

faq.a: Hold Menu+Volume Down on Siri Remote.

title: Siri Remote unresponsive
shortDescription: Remote does not control Apple TV.
fullDescription: Siri Remote uses Bluetooth and needs charging. If unresponsive, first try charging for 30 min via USB-C or Lightning.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair remote
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Back+Volume Up for 5 seconds near Apple TV.

fixSteps.title: Use iPhone as remote
fixSteps.instruction: iOS Control Center > Apple TV Remote.

videoSearchQuery: Apple TV Siri Remote not working

title: HDCP handshake failure
shortDescription: Content blocked due to HDCP negotiation error.
fullDescription: Apple TV cannot establish HDCP 2.2 with downstream chain. Disney+/Netflix content shows error code.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, AVR, Apple TV for 60 seconds.

title: AirPlay not available
shortDescription: iPhone/Mac cannot see Apple TV for AirPlay.
fullDescription: When devices are on different networks or mDNS is blocked, AirPlay fails to discover Apple TV.
symptoms: Apple TV not in AirPlay list

fixSteps.title: Same WiFi network
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure both devices on same SSID (not guest network).

faq.a: Many routers isolate IoT SSID - put Apple TV on main network.

title: tvOS update hangs
shortDescription: Update downloads but will not install.
fullDescription: Apple TV tvOS updates occasionally hang at 'Preparing' or 'Installing'. Usually a 30 min wait resolves. Otherwise DFU restore via USB-C is needed (3rd gen).

fixSteps.title: Restore via Mac
fixSteps.instruction: Use USB-C cable and Finder to restore (3rd gen 4K).

faq.q: Can I restore Apple TV HD?
faq.a: Yes via USB-C cable and Finder.

title: WiFi connection drops intermittently
shortDescription: Streaming pauses as Apple TV loses network.
fullDescription: Apple TV 4K Gen 3 has known WiFi 6 compatibility issues with some routers. Dropping to 5GHz-only or using Ethernet (Gen 3 Ethernet model) usually helps.

fixSteps.title: Force 5 GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Disable 2.4 GHz on Apple TV network.

title: App crashes back to home
fullDescription: Common with Netflix, Disney+, or YouTube after tvOS updates. Delete and reinstall the app usually fixes.

fixSteps.title: Delete and reinstall
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Siri on app, delete, re-download.

faq.a: Yes - log in again after reinstall.

title: Dolby Atmos not detected
shortDescription: Apple TV does not show Atmos badge on compatible content.
fullDescription: Requires eARC on TV or direct HDMI to compatible AVR. Audio Format setting must be Best Available.

fixSteps.title: Set Audio Format Best Available
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Video and Audio > Audio Format.

fixSteps.title: Use eARC HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: TV must have eARC port and certified cable.

faq.a: Only lossy Dolby Digital+ Atmos. eARC for lossless TrueHD Atmos.

title: Apple TV unresponsive/frozen
fullDescription: Occasional freeze on Apple TV - usually a tvOS hiccup. Force restart via Back+TV button.

faq.a: Also works but force restart via buttons is cleaner.

title: Siri voice search unresponsive
shortDescription: Hold Siri button but no response.
fullDescription: Siri requires network and region support. Not all regions have Siri on Apple TV. Also affected by remote mic failure.

fixSteps.title: Check region
fixSteps.instruction: Some regions don't support Siri on Apple TV.
